title: WholeBodyPose: unified whole-body (COCO-WholeBody, 133 keypoints) pose estimation for sign language recognition
description:
WholeBodyPose puts RTMPose (RTMW), ViTPose+ and MediaPipe behind one interface that always returns the 133 COCO-WholeBody keypoints, with the video pipeline, NLMS temporal filtering and visualization that turn sign language videos into training-ready pose sequences. Software of the paper WholeBodyPose: A Unified End-to-End Framework for Sign Language Recognition and Pose-Based Training Data (ICMV 2025, Proc. SPIE 14114, doi:10.1117/12.3096312).

Apache-2.0. Please cite the paper.
notes: If you use this software, please cite: C. Lazo-Quispe, R. Castro-Cruz, G. Bejarano, M. Salazar-Espinosa, WholeBodyPose: a unified end-to-end framework for sign language recognition and pose-based training data, Proc. SPIE 14114, Eighteenth International Conference on Machine Vision (ICMV 2025), 141140A (2026), doi:10.1117/12.3096312.
